record.question: Which one of the procedures mentioned below is not appropriate for appointment of arbitrator?
options: The Controlling Officer of the Engineer-in-Charge shall be the Arbitrator Appointing Authority.
Application in prescribed form, duly filled in, listing out disputes and amount of claim against each dispute will be submitted by the disputing party.
A lawyer should be engaged before submitting application for appointment of Arbitrator.
The party invoking arbitration clause will give details about the claims having been made and its refusal by the other party to justify existence of disputes.
record.explanation: Engaging a lawyer before application is not required.
